Meet Jaren Kump: Utah football captain, All-Conference Honorable Mention nominee, Rimington Trophy watch list honoree, and kinesiology graduate student. In this video, discover how he managed the demanding schedule of Division I football while completing a thesis-based master’s program—and why his research matters.

What you’ll learn:
How Jaren balanced football, academics, and family life.
His groundbreaking research on athlete health after retirement.
Why he chose kinesiology and his advice for future students.

Balancing academics and athletics is no easy feat. Jaren not only made it work—he excelled. From being voted team captain to earning national recognition as a scholar-athlete, his story is one of discipline, resilience, and passion for the game.
Now, as he trains for the NFL draft, Jaren is finishing his thesis on the health challenges athletes face after leaving their sport. His research aims to uncover barriers and solutions to help former athletes thrive beyond the field.

caption:
“To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.”
-Ecclesiastes 3:1

“To make an end is to make a beginning.”
-T.S. Eliot

My career as a Ute has been nothing short of absolutely amazing.  As most people know, I’ve had my ups such as a couple of PAC12 championships, a number of bowl games such as Rose Bowls and a Vegas Bowl win, a lot of big time wins, end of season All-Conference honors, and some of the best memories and friends I could ever ask for.  I’ve also had my downs such as my fair share of time in recovery, lost big time games and a number of experiences and lessons that I had to learn in mostly uncomfortable and unprecedented ways as far as I’m aware of. But that’s just life, and that’s what makes it beautiful.  I absolutely loved my experience at Utah and I thank the great people here who had given me some of the best years of my life.  I hope this end means the beginning of something at least half as amazing.  It means much to me to be able to say “I am forever a Utah Man” GO UTES 🙌🏼

volleyball is my first love and for the last 13 years it has been the most constant thing this life has brought me. no matter where i was, no matter how much i struggled, this sport was here for me through it all. 

to all those i have played with, from club, highschool, and the three universities i had the privilege of being a part of, thank you. volleyball has filled my life with inspiring, strong, passionate women who became my sisters and my forever people. a bond that goes so far beyond the court.

to every coach who believed in me, pushed me, and rooted for me until the very end, thank you for shaping me into the person i am today. your belief meant more than you’ll ever know.

mom and dad, thank you for empowering me to never give up on myself. your constant love and support lit the fire in me that lasted from my first clinic to my final match. 

nana, papa, and my entire ohana, thank you for your unconditional love and support. i am blessed to have been able to carry on the legacy of so many amazing athletes and people that were before me. 

as i finish this chapter of my life, i hope that my story inspires anyone to believe in themselves and never give up. bet on yourself, even when your dreams feel far away, even when the road gets messy. nothing is too big, too unrealistic, or too out of reach if you’re willing to work for it and lead with passion, love, and purpose. 

closing this chapter is sad and scary, but i can’t help but feel gratitude. i’m thankful for every moment, every teammate, every win, every loss, and every lesson this sport gave me. volleyball will forever be a part of me.

thank you, 
leah wilton-laboy 
#5

athlete.name: Jaren Kump
athlete.bio: A relentless protector on the line, this Utah standout combines fierce determination with strategic finesse. Known for his unwavering grit and camaraderie, he thrives in the trenches, blocking for victory.

caption:
Balancing Division I football with graduate research is no small feat — but Jaren Kump, a second-year masters student in health and kinesiology, makes it look easy.

A proud alum of health and kinesiology, Kump is a captain and the starting center for the University of Utah football team. This season he was named a semi-finalist for the William V. Campbell Trophy and earned a spot on the Rimington Trophy Watch List.

Kump is also completing a thesis focused on the challenges athletes face when transitioning out of sport. He is currently recruiting athletes in their final year of eligibility up to five years post-sport to better understand why former athletes experience higher rates of obesity and depression than non-athletes. He hopes his findings will guide future programs that support the physical and mental health of retired athletes.

After football, Kump hopes to become a strength and conditioning coach — a natural fit for someone so committed to athlete wellbeing.

On top of it all, he balances life as a husband and doggy dad.

We’re proud to have Kump represent the College of Health on the field and in the classroom!
#uofu #kinesiology #utahfootball #utes #goutes #morelife

caption:
“Get your recruitment guide today to help ensure your recruitment process flows smoothly!

I have taken a lot of time and effort to create a guide that helps younger athletes understand and progress through their recruitment process. Throughout the guide, there are some helpful tips and tricks that may help when younger athletes need a boost. Some pages outline the importance of one’s personal timeline and how to prepare. Other pages are left unfilled so that the athletes can fill in the blanks using feedback from themselves and/or coaches.

My reasoning for creating this guide is to help younger athletes create a non-stressful experience. Recruiting for myself was very hard and stressful. Most of the time, I was dreading sending out emails and had a hard time figuring out what I wanted at such a young age. I made many mistakes and went through so many learning curves, which made me want to question, “Is it even worth it?” I am hoping that this guide makes the recruitment process easier for these younger athletes by providing them with my knowledge based on my own personal experiences.”

Thank you for being the best coaches a girl could ask for. Thank you for always pushing me to be my best. For years now I have had the pleasure of playing for not only some of the best coaches but the best people and I wouldn’t trade that for anything. Thank you for the pre game talks and the fun warm ups filled with laughter. I love you guys @agourasoftball 

To Redmond: I just wanted to say how much of an impact you have made on my life. Thank you for never giving up on me. I remember a specific conversation we had junior year summer. I was at the cages and it was right before I got recruited. I was venting about how I was feeling about the CO tournament and you talked me through it, but what stuck was when you said “just do what you do” you may not remember or you may not think it impacted me but when you said that your face showed that you truly believed in me. I went on to hit the best I ever had in that tournament and I built my confidence off of that. Thank you for helping me follow my dreams. Thank you for letting me be a part of your family and not only pushing me in sports but pushing me to be a better person. I wouldn’t be where I am without you whether you believe it or not because not only did you care for me but you gave me my best friend. People don’t understand how blessed I am to have you in my corner. In the future I hope more and more girls meet their Redmond. That’s when the softball world will be healed because you not only cared for me in sports but off the field and at the end of the day that’s what changed my life. Thank you. ❤️ @redmond_firecrackers

We are thrilled to celebrate National Signing Day as we honor two outstanding seniors from our program, Seleny Chavez and Taylor Mediano, who are set to take their talents to the collegiate stage in Division 1 softball!

Seleny, our dedicated team captain, will be continuing her athletic journey at the University of San Diego. Taylor our standout pitcher will be showcasing her skills at the University of Utah. These two have been best friends since kindergarten and have built an unbreakable bond through their shared love for the sport. Their hard work, determination, and relentless pursuit of excellence have left an undeniable mark on our softball program. 

Join us in celebrating this special moment in their lives! We can’t wait to see what the future holds for Seleny and Taylor. 🎉

caption:
套一句錚哥說的話 「大家都表現得很棒了，不能因為一場失敗，就忘記我們前面的努力。記住現在的感覺，因為這只會讓我們越來越好！」
第一次入選中華隊，從訓練、比賽，到現在比賽結束，心情從驚訝興奮 、期待緊張、亢奮⋯到最後的一些遺憾 ，就像是個精彩的故事，在三週後完美的結局了。
事前準備的拍照當天，看到錚哥時，偶像就在我的面前，既興奮又不知所措；訓練時看到駿哥，內心充滿澎湃與緊張感，看到他在防守我的時候就害怕，這些內心的經歷也讓我不斷反覆練習與進步。
終於等到上場機會的自己，在球場上享受著對籃球的熱愛，一直到最後拿到銀牌的失落⋯當下就想回去埋頭苦練的心情。
這些情境、心境上沒有人可以體會到的。
我很感謝在這個故事裡的每一個角色，大家都在自己的橋段裡扮演重要的位置。
謝謝中華籃協、謝謝Nike Jerry哥、謝謝阿凱哥、謝謝Coach Tucci、謝謝所有中華隊的教練以及球員，還有謝謝所有支持我、幫助我的所有人，讓我在今年暑假有一個非常難忘的故事、回憶。
我們大家都會繼續努力，也很期待大家再次相聚！

#2024瓊斯盃 #chinesetaipei #戰在一起 #nike

caption:
Kiitos @lpkangasala !❤️

Kausi 2023-24 tuli päätökseen ja kyyneliltä ei vältytty tälläkään kertaa kauden viimeisessä pelissä. Nyt silmät kuitenkin kostui myös aivan jostain muusta syystä kuin pelkästä hävitystä mestaruudesta. Mulla tuli nimittäin päätökseen kolmas ja ainakin hetkeen myös viimeinen kausi Kangasalla.

Tuntuu, että tää aika hujahti ohi silmän räpäyksessä. Sain olla osana upeita joukkueita, joiden myötä pääsin tutustumaan ihaniin ihmisiin. Koettiin yhdessä paljon ikimuistoisia hetkiä välillä nauraen ja välillä itkien. Aika paljon tähän aikaan mahtui myös kehittymistä ja kasvua, niin pelaajana, kuin ihmisenä.

Kangasalasta tuli mulle koti, jonka takia onkin aika haikeat fiilikset tajuta tän ajan tulleen päätökseen. Iso kiitos kaikille ihanille joukkuekavereille, joiden kanssa sain arkea täällä Kangasalla elää. Te ootte tän homman suola! Kiitos myös meidän ammattitaitoiselle staffille, ahkerille seuran talkoolaisille ja innokkaille kannattajille, jotka mahdollistatte tän kaiken. Parempaa paikkaa ensimmäiseksi liigaseuraksi en olis osannut edes kuvitella ja oon niin onnellinen, että päädyin tänne.❤️
#yhes 

Vaikka on haikeet fiilikset jättää tuttu ja turvallinen taakse, oon samaan aikaan tosi innoissani tulevasta. Seuraavaks lähetään ottaan selvää, kuinka pärjätään vähän isommissa ympyröissä!🤩

📷: @juusokuvaa  ja @riiviomaista

caption:
jay-
i miss you so much. more than you can even imagine. when we met, i knew you were gonna become one of my closest friends. i have looked up to for my ENTIRE life and you were the best example i ever had. this whole weekend has felt like a dream and still doesn’t feel real to me. there were so many things you still wanted to do, (like bench 225😭) but all the plans we had for later were gonna be so COOL. you have been with AND stayed with me throughout everything and i couldn’t be more grateful for that. i could have added more pics of you but i feel like these 3 pics are the most fitting for you. the first pic is special because the temple is directly in the middle of us and it’s a blessing to me that we had picture with that. i know that your in a better place jayson and you are as happy as you have ever been. i keep asking why now, why you, why so unexpected, but i ALWAYS remember what you taught me. “everything happens for a reason and that this is gods plan that we have to trust in.” i will never forget that. i love you bro, so much more than words can describe and i wanna see u one last time to just talk and i KNOW that day will come but... until that day comes, fly high jayson robbie murset❤️🤍
